name: part_sztyidx
parts: part: I64 [mode, kmin]: index mode (1: dense composite directory) and smallest p_size
part: U32 directory offsets into the permutation, one per composite key (p_size = kmin + e / T, p_type = key text e % T), nkeys + 1 entries (mode 1)
part: U32 permutation of canonical part rows ordered by (p_size, p_type key, row) (mode 1)
part: U64 offsets of the T p_type key texts of the index (T + 1 entries)
part: U8 bytes of the p_type key texts of the index
part: I64 per-row p_size keys (fallback mode only; empty in mode 1)
part: U64 per-row p_type key numbers (fallback mode only; empty in mode 1)

layout.summary: A secondary composite index of part on (p_size, p_type): a dense directory over the keys (kmin + e / T, key text e % T), e < nkeys, whose entry e is a range of a permutation of the canonical part rows holding exactly the rows with that key, in increasing row order; the T key texts of p_type are stored once as the index's key dictionary.
layout.units: p_size keys are bigint values; offsets are positions in the permutation (U32); permutation entries are canonical part row numbers (U32); key texts are bytes
